Name: Andronicus
Summary: Andronicus was a kinsman of Paul and a fellowprisoner, described as of note among the apostles and in Christ before Paul himself.
KeyStory: Andronicus was a kinsman of Paul and a fellowprisoner, described as of note among the apostles and in Christ before Paul himself.
LifeLesson: Faithfulness before we ever meet the famous is still faithfulness; God notes those who were in Christ early and stood firm.
